description: Source code for the VideoEncodeAccelerator class and related metadata classes in the media namespace, implementing video encoding configuration, metadata comparison, and error handling.

classes.name: BitstreamBufferMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for bitstream buffers, including payload size, key frame flag, timestamp, and various codec-specific metadata.

classes.name: VideoEncodeAccelerator::Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for video encoding, including input format, profile, bitrate, resolution, framerate, and layers.

classes.name: VideoEncodeAccelerator::SupportedProfile
classes.description: Supported encoding profiles with resolution, framerate, and mode details.

methods.name: AsHumanReadableString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the encoder configuration.

methods.name: NotifyError
methods.description: Notifies the client of an error.

methods.name: NotifyErrorStatus
methods.description: Notifies the client of an error status.

methods.name: NotifyEncoderInfoChange
methods.description: Notifies the client of encoder info changes.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the encoder; currently not implemented.

methods.name: IsGpuFrameResizeSupported
methods.description: Indicates whether GPU frame resize is supported.

methods.name: RequestEncodingParametersChange
methods.description: Requests a change in encoding parameters such as bitrate and framerate.
